english.note: Use this for something gained or achieved, especially a rewarding result rather than just any object bought.
Use this for the benefits or results one has gained from an effort or experience.

examples.english: The biggest acquisition from this trip was meeting a few good friends.
examples.traditional: 今次旅行最大嘅收穫係識到幾個好朋友。

examples.english: I gain a lot from this exchange trip.
examples.traditional: 今次交流團令我收穫好大。
